Staraptor

Normal Flying

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Staraptor is a Normal/Flying-type Predator Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 24.9 kg. It evolves from Staravia. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 485.
